name: pr-self-review
description: Review your own pull request in a loop of artifact inspection, third-party review, and prompt audit, fixing findings without asking until a round needs no fix, then tidy the fix commits and push.

interface.shortDescription: Review and fix your own pull request until nothing is left to fix.
interface.longDescription: Runs a pull request through an inspection for leftovers of the work that produced it, a review by an agent that never saw the implementation, and a prompt audit when the diff contains prompts. Findings are judged and fixed one commit at a time without questions, the loop repeats until a round produces no fix, and the fix commits are tidied with a rebase and pushed once.
